rows.prompt: Edit Image 1 and keep everything exactly the same: the identical camera angle, framing and crop, the same woman's arms, freckled skin, gold ring, white smocked sundress and wavy honey-blonde hair at the right edge of frame, the same white balcony top rail and glass balustrade, the same soft bokeh of palms, the flag and the hazy hinterland, and the same warm golden late-afternoon light. The only change: her two hands now loosely cradle a plain matte white ceramic coffee cup, resting it on the flat top of the white rail where her hands already are, her fingers wrapped naturally around it, the cup in sharp focus and the right size for a real coffee cup. Nothing else is added, moved or changed. Photorealistic editorial lifestyle photography.
